bridge2A_symbolic_exact_weyl_kernel.Phi_W_tilde_exact: ((N_bar(tau)**2 - 1)*N_bar(tau)*Derivative(V_u(tau, x), tau) + (N_bar(tau)**2 + 1)*V_u(tau, x)*Derivative(N_bar(tau), tau) + (Phi(tau, x) + Psi(tau, x))*N_bar(tau)**3 + N_bar(tau)**2*delta_N(tau, x))/(2*N_bar(tau)**3)
bridge2A_symbolic_exact_weyl_kernel.static_Vu_residual_when_dNb_nonzero: +(1 + N_bar^2)/(2 N_bar^3) * (d_tau N_bar) * V_u (vanishes iff V_u == 0 OR d_tau N_bar == 0!)

bridge2C_programmatic_cosmology_bounds.caveats: Restricted to curl-free scalar director perturbations u_i = a d_i V_u (transverse vector modes u_i^T open) and assumes u_i tracks the linear matter peculiar-velocity potential V_u = 2 f Phi / (3 H_conf Omega_m) rather than solving the full perturbed AeST/Khronon field equation. Note that C_L^{kk} ~ Phi_W^2 gives a 1.0%-3.0% shift in C_L^{kk} for 1-N_bar in [0.005, 0.015], creating mild tension with ACT DR6 (2%) at the upper end 1-N_bar = 0.015.
